subject: Intranasal Lipid Nanoparticles Deliver mRNA to Restore Spatial Memory in Aged Mice
script: From Agewell Brief: Intranasal Lipid Nanoparticles Deliver mRNA to Restore Spatial Memory in Aged Mice. University of Sydney researchers engineered lipid-encapsulated mRNA nose drops that travel through nasal pathways to reverse spatial memory deficits and shield transgenic mice from Alzheimer's pathology. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
